title: Two copper(II) complexes
caption: In water copper(II) is the blue octahedral [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺. Adding concentrated HCl swaps the six water ligands for four larger chloride ions, giving the yellow-green tetrahedral [CuCl₄]²⁻: the coordination number changes with the ligand.
alt: An octahedral copper ion with six water ligands, and a tetrahedral copper ion with four chloride ligands.
description: [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺: six water molecules around Cu at 90°, octahedral.
